verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bitwarden exposes a Public API, CLI, personal API keys for automation, and an official MCP server (all of which an AI-native builder could integrate against), but there is no evidence of a dedicated, language-specific 'official SDK' (e.g., a bitwarden/sdk repo) and the OpenAPI/swagger spec probes all returned 404, suggesting no machine-readable API contract is published. missing for 10: explicit official SDK repositories/language bindings, published OpenAPI spec, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
